# ==============================================================================
# BENG 183 Final Project
# scRNA-seq + CRISPR guide capture analysis of A375 melanoma cells (RAB1A vs non-targeting control) with Seurat v5
#
# HOW TO RUN
#   1. Create the folder structure (see below) and open BENG183_project.Rproj so RStudio sets the working directory to the project root.
#   2. Open this file and run it top to bottom (Ctrl/Cmd + Enter, or Source).
#
#   BENG183_project/
#   |-- BENG183_project.Rproj
#   |-- data/
#   |   |-- <...>_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
#   |   `-- crispr_analysis/protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv
#   |-- scripts/analysis.R      <- this file
#   `-- results/                <- created automatically
# ==============================================================================

# ---- 0. Packages -------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
pkgs <- c("Seurat", "hdf5r", "ggplot2", "ggrepel", "patchwork", "dplyr")
missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(hdf5r)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

packageVersion("Seurat")   # the original run used 5.3.1
set.seed(183)
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# ---- 1. Locate input files ---------------------------------------------------
```{r}
base <- "C:/Users/ninam/Documents/Bioinformatics/BENG183_FinalProject/BENG183_project"
setwd(base)
h5_file     <- normalizePath(list.files(file.path(base, "data"),
                 pattern = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
crispr_file <- normalizePath(list.files(file.path(base, "data"),
                 pattern = "protospacer_calls_per_cell\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
stopifnot(file.exists(h5_file), file.exists(crispr_file))


```

# ---- 2. Load counts and build the Seurat object ------------------------------
```{r}
counts <- Read10X_h5(h5_file)
str(counts, max.level = 1)   # should list "Gene Expression" and "CRISPR Guide Capture"

a375 <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts       = counts[["Gene Expression"]],
  project      = "A375_CRISPR",
  min.cells    = 3,
  min.features = 200
)
print(a375)                  # expect ~22,238 features x 1,163 cells
```

# ---- 3. Add CRISPR guide assignments as metadata -----------------------------
```{r}
crispr_data <- read.csv(crispr_file, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(crispr_data) <- trimws(rownames(crispr_data))
head(crispr_data)

# match() by barcode (safer than crispr_data[colnames(a375), ], which creates
# NA rows for cells that have no guide call)
idx <- match(colnames(a375), rownames(crispr_data))

a375$num_features <- crispr_data$num_features[idx]
a375$feature_call <- crispr_data$feature_call[idx]
# Cells with two guides have values like "4847|3", which become NA here (expected)
a375$num_umis     <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(crispr_data$num_umis[idx]))

a375$feature_call[is.na(a375$feature_call)] <- "Unknown"
table(a375$feature_call)     # RAB1A-2, Non_Target-1_MS, Non_Target-1_MS|RAB1A-2, Unknown
```

# ---- 4. Standard preprocessing, clustering, UMAP -----------------------------
```{r}
a375 <- NormalizeData(a375)
a375 <- FindVariableFeatures(a375)
a375 <- ScaleData(a375)
a375 <- RunPCA(a375, npcs = 30)

a375 <- FindNeighbors(a375, dims = 1:20)
a375 <- FindClusters(a375, resolution = 0.5)   # ~7 clusters in the original run
a375 <- RunUMAP(a375, dims = 1:20)
```

# ---- 5. UMAP plots -----------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
p_ncount   <- FeaturePlot(a375, features = "nCount_RNA", reduction = "umap")
p_clusters <- DimPlot(a375, group.by = "seurat_clusters", reduction = "umap")
p_guides   <- DimPlot(a375, group.by = "feature_call", reduction = "umap")
p_numis    <- FeaturePlot(a375, features = "num_umis", reduction = "umap")

print(p_ncount); print(p_clusters); print(p_guides); print(p_numis)

ggsave(file.path(base, "results", "umap_nCount_RNA.png"), p_ncount, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(base, "results", "umap_clusters.png"), p_clusters, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(base, "results", "umap_feature_call.png"), p_guides, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(base, "results", "umap_num_umis.png"), p_numis, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)1
```

# ---- 6. Pseudobulk aggregation + scatter plot --------------------------------
```{r}
genes.to.label <- c("GAGE2A", "RAB1A", "TMPRSS15", "RPLP0", "RPSA", "SERPINE2")

agg <- AggregateExpression(a375, group.by = "feature_call", return.seurat = TRUE)
DefaultAssay(agg) <- "RNA"
Cells(agg)
# NOTE: AggregateExpression turns underscores into dashes, so the group names are
# "RAB1A-2" and "Non-Target-1-MS". Using "Non_Target-1_MS" here caused the
# "Too few variables passed" error in the original code.

p1 <- CellScatter(agg, "RAB1A-2", "Non-Target-1-MS", highlight = genes.to.label)
p2 <- LabelPoints(plot = p1, points = genes.to.label, repel = TRUE)
p_scatter <- p1 + p2
print(p_scatter)
ggsave(file.path(base, "results", "pseudobulk_scatter.png"), p_scatter, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# ---- 7. Differential expression (Wilcoxon) -----------------------------------
```{r}
# Ident names keep their original underscores here (this is the Seurat object,
# not the aggregated one).
Idents(a375) <- "feature_call"

# Main comparison: RAB1A-2 vs non-targeting control
de_RAB1A_vs_NT <- FindMarkers(
  a375,
  ident.1 = "RAB1A-2", ident.2 = "Non_Target-1_MS",
  logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.1
)
head(de_RAB1A_vs_NT, 10)
write.csv(de_RAB1A_vs_NT, file.path(base, "results", "DE_RAB1A_vs_NonTarget.csv"))

# Extra comparisons against the double-guide cells (from the original notebook)
de_RAB1A_vs_dbl <- FindMarkers(a375, ident.1 = "RAB1A-2",
                               ident.2 = "Non_Target-1_MS|RAB1A-2")
de_NT_vs_dbl    <- FindMarkers(a375, ident.1 = "Non_Target-1_MS",
                               ident.2 = "Non_Target-1_MS|RAB1A-2")
head(de_RAB1A_vs_dbl)
head(de_NT_vs_dbl)
```

# ---- 8. Volcano plot ---------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# The columns the original volcano code expected (log10_pval, significant, label)
# were never defined in the PDF, so they are built here.
de <- de_RAB1A_vs_NT
de$gene       <- rownames(de)
de$log10_pval <- -log10(pmax(de$p_val_adj, 1e-300))
de$significant <- ifelse(de$p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(de$avg_log2FC) > 1, "Yes", "No")
de$label      <- ifelse(de$gene %in% genes.to.label, de$gene, "")

volcano <- ggplot(de, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = log10_pval,
                          color = significant, label = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +   # No = red, Yes = blue
  geom_text_repel(show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  xlab("Log2 Fold Change") + ylab("-Log10 P-value") +
  ggtitle("Volcano Plot: RAB1A-2 vs Non_Target-1_MS")

print(volcano)
ggsave(file.path(base, "results", "volcano_RAB1A_vs_NT.png"), volcano, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

p_markers <- FeaturePlot(a375, features = genes.to.label,

# ---- 10. OPTIONAL: Seurat v5 CCA integration (from the handout) --------------
```{r}
# Off by default, because the original notebook's numbers (7 clusters, modularity
# 0.8187) come from the un-integrated analysis above. Set to TRUE to try it.
# Not tested against this dataset. FindConservedMarkers also needs the 'metap'
# package, and will error if a cluster has too few cells in one condition.
RUN_INTEGRATION <- FALSE

if (RUN_INTEGRATION) {
  if (!"metap" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) install.packages("metap")

  a375_int <- subset(a375, subset = feature_call %in% c("RAB1A-2", "Non_Target-1_MS"))
  a375_int[["RNA"]] <- split(a375_int[["RNA"]], f = a375_int$feature_call)

  a375_int <- NormalizeData(a375_int)
  a375_int <- FindVariableFeatures(a375_int)
  a375_int <- ScaleData(a375_int)
  a375_int <- RunPCA(a375_int, npcs = 30)

  a375_int <- IntegrateLayers(
    object = a375_int, method = CCAIntegration,
    new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE
  )
  a375_int[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(a375_int[["RNA"]])

  a375_int <- FindNeighbors(a375_int, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:20)
  a375_int <- FindClusters(a375_int, resolution = 0.5)
  a375_int <- RunUMAP(a375_int, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:20,
                      reduction.name = "umap.cca")

  p_int <- DimPlot(a375_int, reduction = "umap.cca",
                   group.by = c("feature_call", "seurat_clusters"))
  print(p_int)
  ggsave("results/umap_integrated_cca.png", p_int, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  Idents(a375_int) <- "seurat_clusters"
  conserved_c0 <- FindConservedMarkers(a375_int, ident.1 = 0,
                                       grouping.var = "feature_call")
  head(conserved_c0)
}
```
